# Bhakti by Agentic Vani

> A modern, mindful Hindu spirituality web app: a digital jap (mantra) counter,
> a mantra library, gods, temples, festivals, vrat guides, daily Panchang and
> the Bhagavad Gita. Published by Bhakti by Agentic Vani
> (https://bhakti.agenticvani.com).

Welcome to Bhakti by Agentic Vani.

This website provides educational information about Hindu mantras, gods,
temples, festivals, vrat (fasting), Panchang and the Bhagavad Gita.

## Important

Practices vary across regions, lineages, and communities. Recommendations are
based on traditional beliefs and should not be interpreted as guarantees of
outcomes, medical advice, or financial advice.

## Primary Topics

- Mantra (with meaning, pronunciation, benefits and how to chant)
- Mantras by purpose (peace, health, protection, prosperity, job, marriage, etc.)
- God / Goddess
- Temple (history, timings, how to reach)
- Festival (story, puja vidhi, dates)
- Vrat / fasting guides
- Bhagavad Gita (chapters, verses, daily shloka)
- Panchang (tithi, nakshatra, Rahu Kaal)
- State-wise temple traditions
